svg.title: diplodocus-sheep-creek-150350 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Reused original generalized Diplodocus geometry, not the measured Sheep Creek skeleton or a diagnostic D. carnegii reconstruction. The collection age envelope does not date this individual exactly to 150 Ma or establish continuous existence.
